description_en: Queries the region IDs of cloud service resources that can be added to Web Application Firewall (WAF) by using the SDK
description_zh: 查询SDK集成的资源的地域ID，主要指ALB和MSE产品
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-resource-region-id --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResourceRegionId

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的WAF实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

ResourceRegionIds.description_en: The region IDs of cloud service resources that can be added to WAF by using the SDK
ResourceRegionIds.description_zh: SDK集成的资源的地域ID列表
